posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
Did you know that End of Days will destroy cards underneath the Dreamer?

 

So, if you've got eight cards underneath her already, you shouldn't have all the other heroes smugly do nothing while you wait for End of Days to finish off all the projections in play and win the game for you.

 

Filed under 'Things I learned beta testing'.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: Since cards under other cards have no text, this means they have no hp either (as this is considered part of the text), therefore aren't targets. So anythign that acts on a target being destroyed when Savage Mana goes off wouldn't do so, but anything that acts on a card being destroyed would do.
